entries.note: Never restate a contract rule here. An earlier revision re-implemented the contract-2 shape in this file and drifted from the shipped rules in two directions at once: it rejected legal executable candidates and accepted env keys the service refuses. The helper now calls validateSchema over the committed contract plus the shared cross-rule modules, so this test cannot disagree with the service. The one thing it still states is the cross rule the reader owns and neither module checks: a dashboard needs contract 2 and a games array needs contract 3. While the committed schema predates contract 3 the helper validates the core with the games array removed and lists the uncovered tier instead of inventing rules for it; when the game lane lands its schema and game-rules.mjs the other branch is taken automatically and nothing here changes.
